title: Tradeable Import Certificates for Strategic Supply Security
abstract: arXiv:2609.20282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent crises have made supply security central to trade policy. We show how tradeable import certificates (TIC) implement targets for domestic production and reliable foreign supply while preserving gains from trade. A single certificate market per country decentralizes the welfare-maximizing allocation under heterogeneous targets, with certificate prices adjusting endogenously as conditions change. TIC robustly protect these targets against a range of deviations from trade agreements. A model of economic coercion microfounds the targets, linking them to shortage salience, supply reliability, bilateral trade dependence, and norms against yielding to coercion. Tariff-subsidy agreements require more information and are more vulnerable to hidden deviations. translated_title: 用于战略供应安全的可交易进口证书
translated_abstract: 近期的危机使供应安全成为贸易政策的核心议题。我们展示了可交易进口证书（TIC）如何在保留贸易收益的同时，实现国内生产和可靠外国供应的目标。每个国家只需建立单一的证书市场，即可在异质性目标下分散化实现福利最大化的配置，且证书价格会随条件变化而内生调整。TIC能够稳健地保护这些目标免受一系列偏离贸易协议行为的影响。我们通过一个经济胁迫模型为这些目标提供了微观基础，将其与短缺显著性、供应可靠性、双边贸易依赖性以及反对屈服于胁迫的规范联系起来。与TIC相比，关税-补贴协议需要更多信息，且更容易受到隐性偏离的影响。虽然共同的碳价格为气候协议提供了自然的焦点，但基于数量的安全目标可能比关税为贸易协议提供更自然的焦点。
tldr: 本文提出可交易进口证书（TIC）机制，通过每个国家单一的证书市场以分散化方式实现国内生产与可靠外国供应目标，在保留贸易收益的同时稳健抵御协议偏离，并论证了这种数量型安全目标比关税更适合作贸易协议的协调焦点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes tradeable import certificates (TIC), which decentralize welfare-maximizing allocations through a single certificate market per country to achieve domestic production and reliable foreign supply targets while preserving gains from trade, offering a more robust and natural quantity-based focal point for trade agreements than tariffs.
